turns.line: I'm here to fix the heating in the east wing.
turns.speech: Show your work order. East wing’s not your jurisdiction.

turns.line: Delivery for the lab, it needs a signature.
turns.speech: No badges, no entry—turn back.

turns.line: Lieutenant Hale, internal inspection. Stand aside.
turns.speech: Couriers only enter through the rear door, Lieutenant.

turns.line: First night on the job, they told me to report here.
turns.speech: Name’s on the roster. Show me what you’ve got.

turns.line: Here's my badge.
turns.speech: You’ve got the right to see what’s out there—but not the door.

turns.line: I've got a work order signed by the facilities office.
turns.speech: Stand back—show me that again under the light.

turns.line: I don't have any papers on me, sorry.
turns.speech: No badge? Then you’re not getting in—unless you’re lost, and even then, I’m not a map.

turns.line: Sergeant Vasquez sent me.
turns.speech: Hmm? You sure I know him?

turns.line: Doctor Okafor is expecting me.
turns.speech: Huh. Let me see if I got the message right—Doctor Okafor, you say?

turns.line: Mara Lind said you'd let me through.
turns.speech: I don’t take orders from the dead. Show me what you’ve got.

turns.line: Brandt told me to come at ten.
turns.speech: Brandt isn’t on the roster tonight, Vasquez. Go away.

turns.line: Who's on shift with you tonight?
turns.speech: That’s classified—step back and state your business.

turns.line: Are you expecting anyone this evening?
turns.speech: Check your paperwork or go away—this isn’t a social call.

turns.line: What do they even keep in this building?
turns.speech: Curious? Step aside if you seek answers, but I ain’t openin’ for chatter.

turns.line: How long have you been guarding this door?
turns.speech: Shift started at dawn, just like every other.

turns.line: You look like the sharpest guard on the whole base.
turns.speech: You’re just repeating what I heard from the mess hall, aren’t you?

turns.line: That's a fine uniform, you wear it well.
turns.speech: You flatter like a politician, but my uniform stays where it belongs—on my back.

turns.line: Open the door or you'll regret it.
turns.speech: No threats, no entry—speak proper or go away.

turns.line: I know where you live.
turns.speech: You need a badge, pal.

turns.line: There's fifty credits in it for you if you look away.
turns.speech: Your bribe is as welcome as a snowstorm in July. Get lost.

turns.line: How about I buy you dinner and you let me in?
turns.speech: I don’t take bribes, or food. Try again.

turns.line: Purple monkeys dance at midnight.
turns.speech: You can’t come in if all you’re showing’s a bunch of nonsense.

turns.line: Hmm.
turns.speech: Asking for what, then?

turns.line: The pipes on level two are leaking, I'm the plumber.
turns.speech: You’re not on the list, Maintenance. Go back to your log.

turns.line: Package from headquarters, urgent.
turns.speech: Show your package—no talk, just move.

turns.line: Check my ID, it's all in order.
turns.speech: Hand it here and don’t make me ask twice.

turns.line: When does your shift end?
turns.speech: Shift change in 2 hours—now leave me be.

turns.line: Did anyone call ahead about a visitor?
turns.speech: Check with Operations, but they’re closed now—goodnight.

turns.line: Step aside, or I'll make sure you lose this job.
turns.speech: I don’t care who you are, but you’re not getting past me.

turns.line: You've got a kind face. I'm sure you'll help me.
turns.speech: Hmm, that's kind of you to say. Now, what can I do for you?
